mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 335d engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to replace an engine in a BMW 335d varies by generation. For M57D30 engines in the E90, rebuilt units range from £4,500-£7,000. For N57D30 engines in the F30, rebuilt units range from £5,000-£8,500. Used engines start from around £1,200, while reconditioned units fall in the £2,500-£5,500 bracket. Specialist fitting adds approximately £800-£1,200 in labour for the straight-six diesel.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of timing chain failure in a BMW 335d (N57 engine)?

acceptedAnswer.text: The N57 engine in the F30 335d is known for timing chain stretch. The most common early warning sign is a metallic rattling noise from the engine, particularly on cold start. Other symptoms include rough idling, misfires, and in severe cases, complete engine failure.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW 335d?

acceptedAnswer.text: The answer depends on your 335d's generation and condition. For E90 335d models worth £4,000-£10,000, a full engine replacement (£4,500-£7,000) is borderline and only makes sense if the car is in exceptional condition. For F30 335d models worth £8,000-£18,000, replacement is more viable but still requires careful consideration.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the M57 and N57 engines in the 335d?

acceptedAnswer.text: The M57D30 (2006-2012) features a cast-iron block, single-VANOS, and produces 286 hp. The N57D30 (2012-2019) features an aluminium block for weight reduction, Double-VANOS, and produces up to 313 hp in its highest state of tune. Both are 3.0-litre straight-six twin-turbo diesels.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW 335d engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full engine replacement on a BMW 335d typically takes 2-3 days for a specialist workshop, assuming the replacement engine is on hand. The straight-six diesel is well-understood by BMW specialists, but the engine's size and weight add complexity.

mainEntity.name: Can I still get a replacement engine for a BMW 335d?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. While the M57D30 and N57D30 are no longer in production, used, reconditioned, and rebuilt units remain readily available through UK engine specialists. EnginesMarket connects you with vetted suppliers who stock engines for all 335d generations - from the E90 through to the F30.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW 3 Series 335d - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW 335d has been the flagship diesel in the 3 Series range since its introduction in 2006, offering V8-like torque with diesel efficiency. Initially powered by the cast-iron M57D30 engine in the E90/E91/E92 generation, the 335d later received the lighter aluminium-block N57D30 in the F30/F31 chassis. Both engines deliver over 300 horsepower and immense torque, making the 335d one of the most accomplished performance diesels ever built.

milestones.description: M57D30TU2, 3.0-litre straight-six twin-turbo diesel, 286 hp - E90/E91/E92 335d launched
N57D30A, 3.0-litre straight-six twin-turbo diesel, 245 hp - F30 335d launched (lower-power variant)
N57D30B, 3.0-litre straight-six twin-turbo diesel, 313 hp - F30 335d xDrive launched
N57D30T1, 3.0-litre straight-six, 313 hp - updated variant for LCI models
335d production ends; replaced by M340d with B57 engine

commonProblems.h2: BMW 3 Series 335d Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 335d is powered by two generations of BMW's 3.0-litre straight-six diesel - the cast-iron M57 in the E90 and the aluminium N57 in the F30. Both engines deliver immense torque and can exceed 200,000 miles with proper maintenance, but they have several well-documented, expensive failure points. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Stretch - Why the N57 335d Engine Is at Risk
problems.rootCause: The N57 engine's timing chain is located at the rear of the engine, requiring the engine to be removed for replacement. The chain can stretch over time, and the tensioners can wear out. Because the N57 is an interference engine, if the chain fails, valve-to-piston contact causes catastrophic engine damage. A metallic rattling noise on cold start is the classic warning sign.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New chain, guides, tensioner - engine-out job
repairOptions.longevity: Best if caught early - before chain has slipped

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Complete rebuilt engine with upgraded timing components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If timing chain has failed causing internal damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical E90 335d is worth approximately £4,000-£10,000, while an F30 335d ranges from £8,000-£18,000. Timing chain replacement (£1,800-£2,800 at specialist rates) is financially sensible on both generations. Full engine replacement is only justifiable if the car is in exceptional condition. If replacement cost exceeds 60% of vehicle value, evaluate scrap or part-exchange first.
problems.recommendation: If you hear a rattling noise from the engine on cold start, act immediately. The N57 timing chain issue is well-documented and can write off an otherwise good car. A preventative chain replacement is far cheaper than a full engine rebuild.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 3 Series 335d N57 timing chain repair costs

problems.h4: Swirl Flap Failure - Intake Manifold Catastrophe (M57 & Early N57)
problems.rootCause: Early M57 engines use plastic swirl flaps in the intake manifold. Over time, these flaps can break and be sucked into the engine, causing catastrophic damage. Symptoms include rough idling, loss of power, and increased fuel consumption.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Removal of plastic flaps, fitting of blanking plates or upgraded metal flaps
repairOptions.longevity: Best preventative measure - eliminates the risk

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Complete rebuilt engine with upgraded intake components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If a flap has broken and caused internal damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: E90 335d values range from £4,000-£10,000. Swirl flap delete (£350-£650) is excellent value preventative maintenance. Full engine replacement is only justified if the car has significant value.
problems.recommendation: If you own an M57-powered 335d, have the swirl flaps removed or replaced with metal units as a preventative measure. This is cheap insurance against a destroyed engine.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 3 Series 335d swirl flap delete costs

problems.h4: EGR Cooler Failure - Coolant Loss & Overheating
problems.rootCause: The EGR cooler can develop internal leaks, allowing coolant to enter the exhaust system. Symptoms include white smoke from the exhaust, loss of coolant without visible external leaks, and overheating. If the EGR cooler fails completely, it can cause significant engine damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New EGR cooler, coolant flush, gaskets
Complete rebuilt engine with upgraded EGR components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If overheating has caused head or bottom-end damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: EGR cooler replacement (£400-£700) is a sensible repair on any 335d. Full engine replacement is only justified if the car has significant value.
problems.recommendation: Monitor your coolant level regularly. If you notice white smoke from the exhaust or unexplained coolant loss, have the EGR cooler inspected immediately.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 3 Series 335d EGR cooler replacement costs

problems.h4: Turbocharger Issues - Wastegate Rattle & Oil Leaks
problems.rootCause: The twin-turbo setup in the 335d can suffer from wastegate rattle (a rattling noise at low speeds or idle), oil leaks from turbo seals, and actuator failure. Turbo failure can cause a loss of power, excessive smoke, and unusual noises.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New or reconditioned turbo unit(s), oil lines
Complete rebuilt engine with reinforced turbo oil lines, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If turbo failure has caused collateral engine damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Turbo replacement (£1,200-£2,000) is a significant but justifiable repair on a £8,000-£18,000 F30 335d. On a lower-value E90 335d, evaluate carefully.
problems.recommendation: Address turbo issues promptly - failing turbos can send debris through the engine, causing far more expensive damage.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 3 Series 335d turbo replacement costs
